title: Desktop & Network Support Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an **L1 IT / Network Support Engineer** to provide first\-level technical support for day\-to\-day IT infrastructure and network operations at the customer location.

The engineer will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving basic IT, endpoint, network, and security\-related issues, while escalating complex incidents to the appropriate L2/L3 teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide **L1 technical support** for desktops, laptops, printers, network connectivity, and other IT infrastructure.
* Monitor network and security infrastructure and identify alerts or service disruptions.
* Troubleshoot basic **LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet and connectivity\-related issues**.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls and access points.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, system configuration and basic access\-related requests.
* Troubleshoot Windows OS, Microsoft 365, email, applications and endpoint\-related issues.
* Assist with installation, configuration and maintenance of IT hardware and software.
* Monitor endpoint/security alerts and escalate incidents as per defined procedures.
* Perform basic checks on antivirus/EDR and other security solutions.
* Log, update and track incidents and service requests through the designated **ticketing system**.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, troubleshooting steps and resolutions.
* Follow defined **SOPs, escalation matrix and SLA requirements**.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 support teams, OEMs and other service providers whenever required.
* Maintain an inventory of IT assets and support documentation.
* Provide regular updates on open incidents and pending issues to the reporting manager/customer SPOC.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Good understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN and Wi\-Fi**.
* Basic knowledge of **network switches, routers, firewalls and VPN**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365**.
* Basic understanding of endpoint security, antivirus/EDR and security best practices.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for hardware, software and network issues.
* Familiarity with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems.
* Good understanding of incident management and escalation processes.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in an **enterprise IT support / NOC / helpdesk environment**.
* Exposure to network/security monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of any firewall platform such as **Sophos, SonicWall, Fortinet, Cisco, etc.**
* ITIL Foundation or relevant networking certification such as **CCNA** would be an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving approach.
* Good verbal and written communication.
* Ability to interact professionally with end users and customer teams.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with remote L2/L3 teams.
* Willingness to learn and work in a customer\-facing environment.

**Key Performance Areas**

* Timely response and resolution of L1 incidents.
* Adherence to agreed **SLA and escalation timelines**.
* Effective monitoring and identification of infrastructure issues.
* Accurate ticket updates and documentation.
* Reduction of recurring incidents through proper troubleshooting and escalation.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* network switches: 2 years (Preferred)
* firewalls : 2 years (Preferred)
* IT infrastructure: 2 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* CCNA certificate (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Systems Support Executive - IT Infrastructure
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**  
**1\. IT Infrastructure Management**

* Troubleshoot minor and major hardware breakdowns and ensure \>95% uptime by providing immediate rectification support — self or through external vendors for repair / replacement.
* Manage (installation, configuration, and support) all network devices, cloud servers, physical servers, software licenses, software databases, security solutions (anti\-virus, etc.), and other business software / subscriptions on various computers, Cloud Systems (AWS), and laptops with \>95% uptime, including Data Backup and Production Backup.
* Install, configure, and monitor system hardware, software, and networks on a routine basis to ensure optimal performance and application of security patch updates.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability — proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks; prepare setup for VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing).
* Evaluate and procure hardware servers, computers, laptops, peripheral devices, security automation tools / gadgets, etc. on behalf of the company with due approval on cost.
* Evaluate and procure software solutions, licenses, domains from registrars, and subscriptions on behalf of the company.
* Extend support for on\-site email installation and remote email server management / rectification.
* Management and maintenance of Data Backup and Restoration checks for on premise and cloud systems as per defined policy / process.
* Management of company's data and voice communication systems in liaison with AMC Partner / UPS / Cables.
* Manage physical positioning and inventory of computers, laptops, peripherals, and software — maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date Asset Inventory at all times.
* Timely submissions of internal reports, Subscription Renewal tracking and timely submission of CSP Evaluation with required details to the Reporting Head.
* Update all relevant trackers on a daily basis; raise CRF requests; perform Incident Reporting and timely escalation to the Reporting Head.

**2\. Information Security Posture \& Standards Management** 

* Own and maintain APT's Information Security posture across the organization in accordance with ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS) standards — as the designated custodian within APT.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps — ensuring accurate and up\-to\-date documentation including Knowledge Base (KB), Trackers, Asset Inventory, and all components of the Network Diagram, as per the ISO process.
* Remediate OS and other security vulnerabilities on a proactive basis; apply security patches and updates within defined TATs; maintain a Vulnerability Register.
* Implement and enforce APT's Information Security Policy across all staff — covering data handling, access controls, acceptable use, and password management.
* Formulate and maintain IT Audit Checklists; undertake periodic technical audit checks of hardware, software, and network infrastructure; report findings to Reporting Head.
* Sensitize company staff on cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and best security practices for data management — conduct ISMS Awareness / InfoSec Awareness sessions for all staff including new joinees and freshers.
* Coordinate with external IT auditors, ISO consultants, and certification bodies during ISMS audits, surveillance audits, and renewal audits — compile and submit required evidence, records, and documentation.
* Maintain and update the Risk Register, Business Continuity Plan (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DR) documentation as per ISO 27001 requirements.
* Ensure access control management — provisioning, modification, and de\-provisioning of system access for all employees, including joiners, transfers, and leavers — within defined TATs.
* Monitor and report on key Information Security metrics / KPIs to the Reporting Head on a periodic basis.

**3\. Team Support \& Knowledge Management** 

* Provide training and documented Knowledge Base (KB) to junior team members and new joiners — covering IT Infra processes, ISMS sessions, and systems orientation.
* Advice the Reporting Head on best management practices for internal systems infrastructure and information security posture.
* Provide weekend / extended support in cases of critical infrastructure incidents or security events.
* Carry out multitasking and prioritization of tasks effectively to meet deadlines — or as directed by the Reporting Head.

**Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* B.Sc. / B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. / BCA / Computer Diploma / Technical Graduate or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Systems, Hardware, Network, and Information Security Management.
* In\-depth knowledge of installing, configuring, and maintaining various hardware and network devices — network switches, access points, routers, firewalls, printers, scanners, etc. is a pre requisite.
* In\-depth knowledge of installing and maintaining various OS and SQL / Oracle databases is a pre\-requisite.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows Server environments (2012–2022\), DNS, Active Directory, Domain Control, IIS, and Group Policy is a pre\-requisite.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) — cloud server management, cloud backup, and cloud security configurations.
* Sound knowledge and practical experience of ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS) — implementation, internal auditing, and documentation is a strong requirement.
* Hands\-on experience with VAPT tools and vulnerability management is an added advantage.
* Sound skills of hardware / software troubleshooting and root\-cause diagnosis.
* Excellent analytical ability and on\-the\-spot thinking — ability to work effectively under pressure and resolve incidents within TATs.
* Basic computer skills, including professional email writing are a must.
* Sound communication, inter\-personal, and documentation skills.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* ITIL Management Certification is a strong added advantage.
* Advanced knowledge of network communication, VLAN management, and network security architecture.
* Advanced knowledge of Server Management — Physical, Virtual (Hyper\-V / VMware), Cloud Server Management, and Email Server Management.
* Prior experience of managing IT infrastructure for 75–100 computers / laptops along with network devices simultaneously.
* Experience in coordinating BCP / DR drills and preparing DR runbooks.
* Familiarity with SIEM tools, endpoint security platforms, and DLP solutions.

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:

title: Network Administrator
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Network Administrator is responsible for managing, maintaining, and securing the organization’s network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs, and firewalls. This role ensures network reliability, security, and the primary goal of Network Admin is to design, implement, and secure the network infrastructure for a S2M Health while ensuring compliance with ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type 2\. The Network administrator will also support EHR systems, Access Control, Fire Alarm Integration, and On\-Premises Networking while troubleshooting and optimizing network performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Network Administration \& Maintenance**

* Install, configure, and manage **routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers**.
* Monitor **network performance, bandwidth usage, and uptime**.
* Implement **network segmentation and VLANs** for improved security.
* Maintain **wireless networks (Wi\-Fi, access points, and authentication mechanisms)**.
* Firmware Upgradation and Configuration Backup
* Maintain Data centre in steady state level.
* CCTV and Access Control Management

**2\. Network Security \& Compliance**

· Configure and manage firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Sonicwall, Sophos, etc.).

· Implement intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), Endpoint security, Advanced Threat Protection, Antivirus Gateway.

· Ensure compliance with ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type 2 regulations.

· Regularly perform network vulnerability scans and security patching.

· Firmware Review and Upgrade

· Configuration Backup.

· Network Hardening and Wi\-Fi Security

**3\. Troubleshooting \& Performance Optimization**

* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, latency, and outages.
* Work with ISPs and third\-party vendors for troubleshooting and upgrades
* Deploying and Utilizing network monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, PRTG, Wireshark) to detect and prevent outages.
* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex network incidents and escalations.

**4\. Firewall and Remote Access Management**

* Support secure remote access solutions (SSL VPN, VPN, IPSec).
* Failover and Load Balancer
* Network Deployment.
* IPS/IDS, APP Control, CFS Control, Routing, NAT, APP Rule,

**5\. Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity**

* Implement and test failover strategies for network resilience and Load Balance
* Ensure backup network connections and alternate routing in case of failures.
* Document disaster recovery (BCP \& DRP) network procedures.
* Critical Network Devices on HA
* Test and collecting Evidence for BCP without production impact.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

✔ **Education:** Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field**.  
✔ **Experience:** 3\+ years in network Admin, or Engineer.  
✔ **Technical Skills:**

* L2 and L3 level Network Troubleshooting.
* Experience with IP routing, VLANs, ACL, and subnetting.
* Familiarity with firewalls, IDS/IPS, Web Filter, Access Policy.
* Knowledge of wireless networking (802\.11 standards, WPA2/WPA3 security).
* Certifications with CCNA, CCNP are added advantage

**Project Deliverables:**

✔ Network Architecture Diagram  
✔ Firewall \& Security Policies Documentation  
✔ Network Monitoring \& Performance Reports  
✔ Incident Response Plan for Security Threats  
✔ Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP)  
✔ Compliance Report (ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 2\)

**Soft Skills:**

✅ Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills  
✅ Ability to work independently and as part of a team  
✅ Excellent communication and documentation skills  
✅ Quick decision\-making and analytical skills

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Regular / Permanent

**Salary:** ₹3,50,000 \- ₹ 5,50,000 per year

**Experience:** 3 \- 5 years (Required)

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in computer science or IT

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹550,000\.00 per year

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Network administration: 3 years (Required)
